name: PD 162 was established by Ordinance No. 18038, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 9, 1983. Ordinance No. 18038 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 162 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 162 was established by Ordinance No. 18038, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 9, 1983. Ordinance No. 18038 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 162 is established on property generally located southwest of the southwest line of Garden Grove Road and northwest of the northwest line of Belt Line Road. The size of PD 162 is approximately 44.49 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-162.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the lot arrangement and street pattern shown on the city plan commission-approved development plan, which is labelled Exhibit 162A. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk of the county in which the property is located. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.106.USES. Development is limited to detached dwelling units for single-family uses only. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.107.DENSITY. Development is limited to a maximum of 240 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.108.DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. Unless otherwise provided in this article, development standards for this PD are the same as those for an R-5 Single-Family District. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.109.COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage in this PD is 50 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.110.SETBACKS. A minimum front yard setback of 25 feet must be provided on all lots, except that a 10-foot setback may be provided on the longer street frontage of a corner lot, as shown on the approved development plan. A minimum side yard setback of five feet and a minimum rear yard setback of 20 feet must be provided on each lot. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.111.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: Screening Wall
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.112.SCREENING WALL. A six-foot-high masonry screening wall must be erected and maintained along the Belt Line Road frontage, as shown on the approved development plan. The owners of the lots on which the wall is located are responsible for maintaining the walls. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.113.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development in this PD must comply with all codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-162.114.PAVING.
(a)All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of Division 51-4.300, “Off-street Parking and Loading Regulations.”
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.115.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-162.116.ZONING MAP. PD 162 is located on Zoning Map No. O-12. (Ord. Nos. 18038; 25508)
